text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAHHH!! We took the top of Mt. 
Fujiーーーーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Unfortunately, it seems you fell just 
one step short.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think she's elusive, once 
her fighting spirit ignites, she's 
unstoppable... Truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... And here I thought I had it in 
the bag today...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You guys made for one heck of a mountain 
range! Thanks to you, my climbing heart is 
maxed out!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We have battled many times before, and 
today was yet another fantastic contest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Lastly, let me give you this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I may not know what the Eden you seek 
is... but I'm cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the one. *gulp*... I-I'm 
gonna look...
